migrations.description: Create the Stage 3 CWD physical architecture and canonical Week 1 activity
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT (to_regclass('public.activity_sessions') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.response_traces') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.confidence_scales') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='activities' AND column_name='config') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-who-is-excluded' AND model='confidence_weighted_response'));

migrations.description: Add immutable CWD session semantic snapshots and one-open-session protection
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='activity_sessions' AND column_name IN ('model_snapshot','variant_snapshot','config_snapshot','schema_version_snapshot','confidence_scale_snapshot')) = 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='activity_sessions' AND indexname='uq_activity_sessions_one_open'));

migrations.description: Extend CWD with the bounded self_audit diagnostic variant
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='response_traces' AND column_name IN ('committed_diagnostic_profile','diagnostic_target_id','final_diagnostic_profile')) = 3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w9-audit-own-confidence' AND variant='self_audit' AND active=false));

migrations.description: Populate the remaining four canonical B1141 social CWD activity configurations
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) = 4 AND bool_and(active = false)) FROM activities WHERE id IN ('b1141-w2-bad-apple-or-system-cwd','b1141-w5-biometric-data','b1141-w6-sky-premier-league-1992','b1141-w7-universal-code');

migrations.description: Apply Stage 4 academic language and configuration revisions to all six inactive B1141 CWD instances
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) = 6 AND bool_and(active = false) AND bool_and(config IS NOT NULL)) FROM activities WHERE id IN ('b1141-w1-who-is-excluded','b1141-w2-bad-apple-or-system-cwd','b1141-w5-biometric-data','b1141-w6-sky-premier-league-1992','b1141-w7-universal-code','b1141-w9-audit-own-confidence') AND model='confidence_weighted_response';
